messages:
Meera (Docs): Quick sync — I'm opening a PR to standardize naming and tone across the migration guide, SDK snippets, and a few doc examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
Alex D: on it. can you list the high-priority renames? want to make sure we don't break customer examples in the repo.
Meera (Docs): High priority: 
- 'redwood' -> 'Redwood Inference' in prose, but keep package/module names lowercase in code samples.
- replace 'client' usage with explicit client class names for clarity (e.g., RedwoodClient).
- prefer active voice and short imperative sentences in guides.
Julia (SDK): For code snippets: I can automate some changes but will need a clear mapping. examples: 
```
# current public example (bad)
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="<KEY>")
resp = client.generate("Summarize this...")
```
Suggested replacement: 
```
# suggested (preferred)
from redwood_inference import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(auth_token=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.text.generate(prompt="Summarize this...", model="rwd-compat:1")
```
Julia (SDK): Note — the SDK rename touches package imports; I can land a compatibility shim in the SDK repo if we want a smoother transition.
Ben (Platform PM): +1 to the shim approach. We should also add a short migration note at the top of the guide with a one-line regex for maintainers.
Samir (Docs reviewer): Can we also standardize how we surface model identifiers? sometimes we use 'rwd-compat' and sometimes full 'rwd-compat:1'. prefer the latter for accuracy.
Meera (Docs): Agreed — require explicit model tags in examples. I'll update the style checklist: 1) branding casing 2) client class 3) explicit model versions 4) imperative voice.
Alex D: timeline? I have bandwidth to run a grep/replace and open PRs for the example folders tomorrow.
Julia (SDK): I'll prepare the shim PR and unit test changes. ETA EOD tomorrow.
docs-bot: Pull request created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — status: draft.
Meera (Docs): OK — owners: Alex (examples bulk renames), Julia (SDK shim + tests), Samir (final docs review). I'll do the style checklist and migrate the migration guide intro.
Ben (Platform PM): We should also notify Solutions and Support channels before the public deploy — to warn customers about import name changes in code samples.
Samir (Docs reviewer): I'll draft a short ops note after review.
Alex D: quick question on tests — do we run snippet validation? I can wire a CI check to run examples with the shim.
Julia (SDK): yes, CI snippet runner exists in devex. I'll add a small fixture to accept both client names during the transition window.
Meera (Docs): Perfect. Action items: 
- Alex: open example PRs (bulk) — due tomorrow AM
- Julia: SDK shim + tests — due EOD tomorrow
- Samir: review PRs and prepare ops note — due day after
- Meera: update style checklist and migration guide intro — due tomorrow AM
Meera (Docs): Anything else?
Ben (Platform PM): Ping me if we need to extend the compatibility window.
Samir (Docs reviewer): LGTM. :+1:
Meera (Docs): Thanks everyone — leaving this thread pinned for follow-ups.
